name: Samsung DW80 Water Thermistor
purpose: DW80R506* §4-1 tC — thermistor table ~49.12 kΩ @ 25°C (77°F); powered signal 0.2–4.5 V.
failureModes: Open or short — tC check code
Frozen water path — tC during heater operation
testingTips: Disconnect connector before bench ohms (CN505 pins 5–6)
Compare to table at known tub water temperature
Verify 0.2–4.5 V with power on when harness connected

name: Samsung DW80 Circulation Motor Coil
purpose: DW80R506* troubleshooting — circulation motor coil approx. 5.8 Ω.
failureModes: Open coil — no wash / nozzle does not inject
Foreign material in water passages — mechanical no-wash
testingTips: Verify nozzle rotation and spray in Smart Install step 2

name: Samsung DW80 Detergent Dispenser
failureModes: Relay fault on main PBA — 120 V missing at CN101/CN202 during operate
testingTips: Confirm detergent loaded and dispenser lid not blocked by racks
Dispenser operates 130 s in Smart Install Auto step 3

name: Samsung DW80 Dry Fan Motor
purpose: DW80R506* dry troubleshooting — dry fan coil approx. 150 Ω; FC when RPM <3000.
failureModes: Open winding — poor dry / FC code
Fan runs but poor dry — rinse aid empty or thermal actuator fault
testingTips: Fan runs 30 s in Smart Install step 5 / manual step 5
Check CN701 BLDC fan on applicable models separately

name: Samsung DW80 Dry Thermal Actuator
purpose: DW80R506* dry troubleshooting — thermal actuator approx. 1.45 kΩ.
failureModes: Open actuator — auto door dry path fails
120 V missing at CN101/CN201 during operate — main PBA relay
testingTips: Auto Door Open actuator tested in Smart Install step 5 / manual step 7
dC3 when door open not sensed after actuator runs
